name: Takeoff, reporting and device integrations
summary: The remaining integrations: Togal takeoff results, the Slack activity feed, a Power BI connector, wearable capture (smart glasses) and the Keystone back-office integration.

roles.note: No permission string covers these integrations. The Togal webhook is public; the Slack feed runs on every saved progress audit entry; Power BI, wearable and Keystone have no code in the repositories read here.

actions.note: PRD says users with administrative rights

nfr.statement: Delay between a category or stage change and the matching Slack update.
nfr.open_question: Hourly digest as the PRD says, or immediate as the code does (INTG-REQ-027)?

requirements.title: Slack updates on category and stage changes
requirements.statement: The PRD asks for hourly Slack updates on category additions and changes and stage changes, from an Onboarding bot for projects without assets and a Backtracking bot for projects with assets. Today each tracked progress audit entry made by a customer (non-support) user is posted straight away to one configured Slack channel.

dispute.summary: SRC-037 slack-bot US-001 and FR-002..003 describe an hourly digest split by whether the project has assets. The code posts every tracked audit event as it is saved to a single channel, skipping support users. Product to say which feed is wanted and who reads it.

requirements.title: A Power BI connector for Track3D data
requirements.statement: Users with administrative rights can download a Track3D connector file for Power BI, sign in with their Track3D credentials, and pick the data tables to import. Access is limited to signed-in platform users; guest access and filtered sharing are out of scope.

requirements.title: Capture with smart glasses (proof of concept)
requirements.statement: A proof of concept lets a user pair Ray-Ban Meta glasses with the mobile app over Bluetooth, choose a structure and camera, capture, sync to the phone, upload to Track3D, and see the processed result on the platform. Failed connections or uploads are retried and the user is told.

requirements.title: Keystone creates projects and exchanges photos with Track3D
requirements.statement: Keystone can create a Track3D project through an API call. Track3D fetches Keystone's budget list, uploads photos to Keystone (with a manual retry when uploads fail), and emails site contacts what they need for capture. All calls are authenticated, retried on failure and logged.
